neighbours.label: The character 重 and the word heavy (weight or seriousness); other adjectives stay low
fire: 他每天背着一个很重的大包上学。
这是一个非常重要的问题。
He carried a heavy bag up the long hill.
Heavy rain flooded the lower streets.
そのかばんはとても重いです。
The trucks left heavy ruts in the mud.
A heavy door closed behind them.
quiet: 他每天背着一个很小的书包上学。
这是一个非常简单的问题。
He carried a small bag up the long hill.
Light rain fell on the lower streets.
そのかばんはとても安いです。
The trucks left at noon for the coast.
A wooden door closed behind them.
